name: Do I need permits for minor cosmetic updates, or only for major structural changes?

mainEntity.name: Do I need permits for minor cosmetic updates, or only for major structural changes?

acceptedAnswer.text: Generally, minor cosmetic updates that do not alter the structure, plumbing, or electrical systems, such as painting, new flooring, or replacing light fixtures in the same location, do not require permits. However, permits become necessary when changes impact structural integrity, involve adding or moving walls, reconfiguring plumbing lines for a new shower layout, or upgrading electrical panels for a luxury kitchen. It's crucial to distinguish between surface-level improvements and those that affect safety or code compliance. AKN Design Group always provides clear guidance on permit requirements specific to your project scope during the initial design and planning phases.
acceptedAnswer.description: Minor cosmetic updates typically don't need permits, but any work affecting structure, plumbing, or electrical systems does. AKN provides guidance based on your project's scope.
